# LobeHub

> LobeHub is an AI Agent platform for discovering, building, and collaborating on intelligent assistants with support for multiple models and marketplace integrations.

LobeHub provides a comprehensive ecosystem for AI agent development, featuring marketplaces for agents, skills, and MCP servers, along with cloud infrastructure for team collaboration. The platform supports leading AI models including Claude, GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek with flexible pricing and multi-platform availability.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Agent Marketplace
- Skills Marketplace
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Multi-Agent Systems
- Claude
- GPT
- DeepSeek
- LobeHub Cloud
- Workflow Automation
- AI Collaboration
- Agent Builder
- Compute Credits
- Model Pricing
- Team Collaboration

## Core Platform

- [LobeHub Homepage](https://lobehub.com): LobeHub homepage: AI Agent platform for discovery, building, and team collaboration
- [Agent Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/agent): LobeHub Agent marketplace: discover, customize, and deploy AI assistants
- [Skills Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/skills): LobeHub Skills marketplace for AI coding assistants with SKILL.md format
- [MCP Servers Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/mcp): LobeHub MCP marketplace: Model Context Protocol servers for Agent systems

## Pricing & Access

- [Plans & Pricing](https://lobehub.com/pricing): LobeHub pricing plans with compute credits, free trial, and multi-model support
- [Model Pricing](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/subscription/model-pricing): LobeHub Cloud AI model pricing: GPT, Claude, Gemini token costs and billing
- [Download LobeHub](https://lobehub.com/downloads): LobeHub desktop and mobile app downloads for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android
